 Order

. 
In this petition, the petitioners claim to be the owner of the land measuring 2.5 kanals in survey in Nos. 966 Min, 967 Min, 968 Min, 967/1 Min and 980/1 Min, situated at Village Barmeen [for short 'the subject land'] which, as per the petitioners has been utilized by respondent No. 6 for construction of an alternative road from Udhampur to Gordhi.
It is submitted that the process for acquisition was initiated under Section 4(1) of the J&K Land Acquisition Act, by virtue of notification dated 28.10.2014 but the same has not been taken to its logical end.
The petitioners pray for a direction to the respondents to finalize the award and, accordingly,
disburse just and fair compensation to the petitioners for the land that has come under acquisition.

Respondent Nos. 1, 2, 4 and 5 have filed their objections in which the respondents have taken a clear stand that the process of acquisition which was initiated by the Collector Land Acquisition,
Prem Nath Sharma And Ors vs State And Ors on 19 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12884466/
1 Ramnagar under Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act for acquisition of land measuring 4 kanals and 13 marlas falling under Khasra Nos. 960 Min, 961 Min, 966 Min, 967 Min and 980/1 Min situated at Village Barmeen has been carried forward and has culminated into passing of the final award which was announced by the Collector Land Acquisition vide final award No.
SDMR/LA/2016-17/41-46 dated 12.04.2016.
In view of the aforesaid stand of the respondents, the relief claimed by the petitioners for issuing direction to the respondents to pass final award stands granted to the petitioners.
